## Overview

Template context of the popover content (`let-arrow="arrow" let-placement="placement"
let-open="open"`). Values are signals so `OnPush`/zoneless templates stay in sync.

- **Kind:** Interface
- **Source:** [packages/primitives/src/popover/popover.types.ts:27](https://github.com/Andersseen/quartz/blob/main/packages/primitives/src/popover/popover.types.ts#L27)

| `readonly arrow` | `Signal<OverlayArrowGeometry \| null>` | Arrow geometry of the open popover; `null` until measured or without `arrowSize`. |
| `readonly placement` | `Signal<OverlayPlacement \| null>` | Resolved physical placement after flip; `null` until measured. |
| `readonly open` | `Signal<boolean>` | Mirrors the trigger's open state (`true` while the content exists). |
